entries.1d23f0ee4b10a361: The company is a casting manufacturer headquartered in Himeji, Hyogo Prefecture, and forms a group with four consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.373d8fe542a1f1c1: A foundry manufacturer in Himeji that focuses on castings such as steel rolling rolls and automotive mold castings, and also handles environmental equipment and friction materials.
entries.694915450054c4d2: A business in which the consolidated subsidiary KOGI Service Co., Ltd. carries out security and other operations for the company's Himeji East Plant and Himeji West Plant; it is not included in the reportable segments.
entries.823660417478b6b8: The company is a casting manufacturer headquartered in Himeji, Hyogo Prefecture, and forms a group with four consolidated subsidiaries. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 766, and the company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.89acfa05357d05bc: The main business, which manufactures and sells steel rolling rolls, ingot molds, automotive die castings, dense bars (continuously cast iron bars), general castings, aluminum alloy cast products and more.
entries.8d926a44bd97a597: A business that manufactures and sells friction materials and other products for automobiles, railways and industrial machinery.
entries.bc4e44fe6f56959f: A business that manufactures and sells environment-related equipment and machinery products, undertakes civil engineering and construction work, and sells solar power.
